scope: TotalEnergies Morocco direct tariff channel only

modeling.cpo_operator: station-specific; do not infer from site brand
modeling.app_source_access_network: TotalEnergies / Club EV-Charge when native app data is used

interpretation: For TCC, when a TotalEnergies Morocco station has no explicit direct tariff or the native tariff field is null, charging is treated as free at 0 MAD. If an explicit TotalEnergies direct tariff is available, that tariff overrides this fallback. This rule does not alter CPO attribution or live status modeling.
